# Makon Coworking

> Makon is a coworking space in central Tashkent, Uzbekistan, at 11 Lashkarbegi Street (Lashkarbegi ko'chasi, 11). Every resident has their own dedicated desk. The website is in Uzbek, Russian and English.

## Key facts

- Name: Makon Coworking (also "Makon", "Makon kovorking")
- Address: 11 Lashkarbegi Street, Akai City residential complex, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
- Getting there: 2-minute walk from Hamid Olimjon metro station; parking available
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00–19:00; closed on Sunday
- Desks: 15, each assigned to one resident
- Included for residents: dedicated desk, Wi-Fi, free printer, free personal locker, books for residents
- Phone: +998 99 070 44 41, +998 95 747 44 41
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/makon_coworking/
- Yandex Maps: https://yandex.uz/maps/org/233840017594/

## Membership (monthly)

- Makon residents: $250 per month — dedicated desk, Wi-Fi, free printer, free personal locker, books, resident community.
- Travel agents: $350 per month — everything residents get, plus a licence to operate, financial, legal and organisational services, and ready client requests. Agents work from Makon without opening their own office.
- Payment: QR code (UzQR) only; cash is not accepted.

## Additional services

SMM, marketing, and a microphone and other equipment for video and podcasts. Ask Makon for details.

## Who it is for

People who have their own work and want to grow: students, targeting specialists, freelancers, entrepreneurs and people starting out as travel agents.
